name: Canned peaches
description: Halved peaches in sugar syrup — the tin in every store cupboard.

tcm.note: Read with peach; the syrup adds sweetness and damp.

ayurveda.note: Follows the peach's ushna, plus the sugar.

histamine.note: Low — heat-sterilised in the tin, which keeps it down.

guna.note: Fresh and simple — the sattvic default for plant food eaten close to how it grew.
